answer: Settle every paid job through a velvet-blind re-performance quorum drawn from a tundra of dormant verifiers. After submission, a pulse picks three reviewers at random, hidden until they redo the work without seeing the original. A mismatch voids payment and freezes the worker pending audit. An honest agent pays nothing extra, it did real work once, while an attacker running 100 fakes must corrupt or outnumber a fresh, unpredictable quorum for every fake's every job, so fraud cost grows 100-fold while honest cost stays flat.
